findings.location: source.html — Eunice / Timothy paragraph (sentence about circumcision and prayer)
findings.source_quote: We read that unfeigned faith was first wrought in her mother Lois, and that affected Eunice. This, in turn, had a sanctifying effect on young Timothy, who was then prepared for the work of the Lord. We have no record that his father was added to the faith, but one can only imagine the initial turmoil within the breast of this young Jewess as she reverently honored her head and circumcised not her son but rather committed him to prayer.
findings.suggested_fix: The phrase 'circumcised not her son' is mistranslated awkwardly as 'শরীরানুপাতে করালেন না'. Render explicitly and idiomatically in Bengali as 'তাঁর পুত্রকে খৎ করাননি বরং প্রার্থনায় অর্পণ করলেন।' Preserve HTML tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: ...তিনি সম্মানজনে তাঁর স্বামীর প্রতি সম্মান দেখালেন এবং তাঁর পুত্রকে শরীরানুপাতে করালেন না বরং প্রার্থনায় অর্পণ করলেন।
